name: THE SUMERIAN — LTX PRODUCTION PIPELINE v1

parameters.content:
## 01–03 · RECEIVE, VALIDATE, NORMALIZE
Webhook (header key) or Form (basic auth) → one JSON shot manifest.
Internal schema is translated to the current LTX v2 schema in **03**. Swap the trigger for a direct API later without touching the rest.

## 04–05 · SAFETY / APPROVAL GATE
`generation_authorized` must be **true**. Cost estimate vs `max_generation_cost`. SHOT_ID+VERSION duplicate check, then a **SUBMITTING** reservation row is written *before* any paid call.

## 06–09 · ROUTE, PREPARE, SUBMIT (PAID)
Only path that spends LTX credits. No automatic retries on submit.

## 10–12 · ASYNC POLLING
Wait 20 s → GET job → bounded loop (max 45 polls / 20 min). Transient errors tolerated 5×.

## 13–16 · CAPTURE → LIBRARY → REVIEW_REQUIRED
Completed clips are **never** auto-approved. LTX URLs expire: archive promptly.

## ERROR · HANDLE FAILURE
One structured error shape. Updates the library row only when this run created the reservation. Credentials are never included.

Polling in the background; the result lands in the Production Library as REVIEW_REQUIRED. Check status via the shot-status webhook.', warnings: c.warnings }; })(), null, 2) }}
